record_kind: Candidate and correction history, not a publication receipt

owner_brief.application: LEVEL-DESIGN.md retains experience spine, wide-linear alternatives, observation, loops, retreat, environmental causality, contrast and graybox testing before final detail. Only the Floodgate clinic-market seam is implemented; the other chapter replacement briefs remain planned.

native_entry_failure.cause: The pause-view select was inserted before a nested button using the wrong DOM parent, producing NotFoundError before XR entry.
native_entry_failure.correction: Use the entry button's actual parent and assert a non-fatal title before entry. No assertion was removed.

first_automated_spatial_acceptance.visual_review: Requires correction, despite automated passes. Existing roofs/foreground facades obscured the survivor in open miniature views; oversized terrace signs and a duplicate generic task label obstructed the over-shoulder camera. This was not final-art approval.

corrections: Open top/front also cut away corresponding world presentation, without changing gameplay collision or detection.
Zoom and submerged focus retain the survivor inside the display's vertical range.
Lower/smaller terrace signs, a single authored latch marker and a folded open shutter clear the over-shoulder view.
Native diorama cases add finite firing/reload and survivor-origin trace assertions.
Inactive stored diorama preferences no longer suppress ordinary desktop underwater fog.
A snap-turn frame suppresses firing so it cannot use a stale pre-turn aim ray.
image_review_revision.native_acceptance: Consult this run and the final PR checks; this candidate history does not predeclare a result.

retained_station_failure.cause: The driver stopped at z=-62.400099 while the exit is at -65, outside the actual 2.4-unit interaction radius; an ineffective E press was followed by a player death.
retained_station_failure.correction: Walk to -64 and assert physical proximity before pressing E. Enemy statistics, damage, resources and extraction gates are unchanged.

local_navigation_failure.correction: The old west-ruin footprint blocked the intended new approach. Its authored collapsed end was shortened to make a real route; no teleport or collision bypass was added.

local_browser_boundary: Local browser navigation was blocked by net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. No policy bypass was attempted. Native acceptance uses authorized GitHub Actions Chromium and real HTTP/WebGL.
preservation: Seven existing chapter slots and identities, all original required objectives, stable shelters, v1-v4 checkpoints, chapter banks, finite resources, Xbox presets, original art/audio and licenses remain. Only the first clinic-market graybox seam is redesigned. Presentation preferences are separate from saves.
evidence_boundaries: XR acceptance uses mock session, head/controller/hand poses and buttons with the real browser, renderer and game. It is not physical Quest 3 or real-camera passthrough proof.
The clinic route fixture has defeated enemies to isolate collision, gate, camera and save behavior. Living-enemy mission acceptance is separately retained.
AR placement is recenterable reference-space placement, not a surface hit test, persistent room anchor or real-room depth occlusion.
No physical Quest/Xbox, subjective art/audio, unfamiliar-player pacing, comfort, frame-rate or AAA approval is implied.
release_gate: Remove temporary write-enabled assembly tooling, run exact-source permanent regression, inspect native captures, merge without dropping concurrent work, publish, then compare actual public bytes before claiming delivery.
